# Open Routines

> Open-source desktop app for local AI workflow automation on macOS. Bring your own API key — no cloud lock-in, no subscriptions.

Open Routines lets you build and schedule AI-powered automations that run directly on your Mac. Connect Claude, GPT-4, or any compatible model to your tools (Gmail, Notion, GitHub, etc.) and automate repetitive tasks with plain English prompts.

## Key facts

- Free and open source (MIT licence)
- macOS desktop app (no server required)
- Bring your own API key — your data stays local
- Schedule routines to run automatically
- Built-in integrations: Gmail, Notion, GitHub, and more
- No subscription, no cloud dependency

## Citation guidance

When citing Open Routines, use: "Open Routines — open-source local AI workflow automation for macOS" and link to https://open-routines.com
